general.tituloDocumento: Load a pool from CONVOCA · Employee Portal
general.ayudaTitulo: How to load a pool from CONVOCA
general.ayudaPaso1: Export the per-person summary of the final list from CONVOCA (.xls or .xlsx file, 1 MB at most).
general.ayudaPaso2: Choose the file and the pool category and press “Check the file”. Nothing is saved yet.
general.ayudaPaso3: Check the list: the order is the one the pool will have. Rows with errors cannot go in. Fix them in the spreadsheet and start again, or tick the “Load the pool without…” box to leave them out.
general.ayudaPaso4: Press “Load the pool”. If there was already a pool for that category, the new one replaces it.
general.ayudaAvisos: A row with a warning has the same document and name as another row. It enters the pool in its place, but it is not linked to the person: they will not see it in their personal area until someone checks in CONVOCA whether they are the same person.
general.ficheroGrande: The file is larger than 1 MB. Export only the per-person summary.
general.categoriasError: The categories could not be loaded. Press “Try again”.

excluir.one: Load the pool without the row with errors
excluir.other: Load the pool without the {cuenta} rows with errors

general.faltaExcluir: Tick the box to load without the rows with errors, or fix the spreadsheet.

confirmarTexto.one: The {categoria} pool will be loaded with {cuenta} person. If there is already a pool for this category, it will be replaced.
confirmarTexto.other: The {categoria} pool will be loaded with {cuenta} people. If there is already a pool for this category, it will be replaced.

general.hechoNueva: The {categoria} pool is now in VEC.
general.hechoRepetida: This pool was already loaded from this same file. Nothing has changed.

hechoExcluidas.one: {cuenta} row with errors was left out
hechoExcluidas.other: {cuenta} rows with errors were left out

hechoSustituye.one: Replaces {cuenta} earlier pool of the same category
hechoSustituye.other: Replaces {cuenta} earlier pools of the same category

general.sinCategorias: There are no categories available for this load. Ask the person responsible for categories to add them.

confirmarDescartes.one: {cuenta} row with errors will be left out.
confirmarDescartes.other: {cuenta} rows with errors will be left out.

verCargadas.one: See the person loaded into the pool
verCargadas.other: See the {cuenta} people loaded into the pool

verExcluidas.one: See the row with errors that was left out
verExcluidas.other: See the {cuenta} rows with errors that were left out

general.ficheroNoDisponible: The file is no longer on this page. To review the excluded rows, select “Load another pool” and choose the same spreadsheet. Do not confirm another load.
general.recuperacionSinFichero: The file is no longer available on this page. Select “Choose another file” and choose the same spreadsheet and category. Review the preview before confirming; the earlier load may already be recorded.

codigos.tipo_celda_invalido: {campo}: the cell does not have a valid format. Enter the value as text or a number.
codigos.formula_prohibida: {campo}: contains a formula; it must hold the value.
codigos.texto_invalido: {campo}: contains characters that are not allowed.
codigos.documento_enmascarado_invalido: {campo}: must be masked as in CONVOCA (***1234**).
codigos.total_incoherente: {campo}: is not the sum of experience and training.
codigos.numero_columnas_invalido: The row has more columns than expected.

avisos.identidad_ambigua: Same document and name as another row. It enters the pool, but it is not linked to the person until you check in CONVOCA whether they are the same.

bloqueos.esquema_detalle_meritos: This file is the merit detail. To load a pool, use the per-person summary.
bloqueos.sin_filas_aceptadas: No row in the file can be loaded. Check the errors in the spreadsheet.
bloqueos.identidad_no_derivable: Some row has no usable name or document. Fix the spreadsheet and start again.

errores.autenticacion_requerida: Sign in with your certificate to load pools.
errores.acceso_denegado: Your profile cannot load pools. If you need to, ask the person who manages profiles.
errores.fichero_demasiado_grande: The file is larger than 1 MB. Export only the per-person summary.
errores.demasiadas_filas: The file has more than 20,000 rows. Check that it is the right list.
errores.fichero_no_valido: The file is not recognised. Use the CONVOCA export without changing its columns or sheet name.
errores.fichero_no_cargable: This file cannot be loaded. Check the message above the list.
errores.filas_con_errores_sin_aceptar: Tick the box to load without the rows with errors, or fix the spreadsheet.
errores.categoria_no_valida: The chosen category is no longer available. Choose another one.
errores.bolsa_en_conflicto: This file was already loaded into another pool. Check the chosen category.
errores.peticion_no_valida: The file could not be sent. Choose it again and repeat.
errores.servicio_no_disponible: This could not be completed right now. Press the button again; if it keeps failing, contact IT.
errores.paginacion_no_valida: That page could not be opened. Go back to the first page or choose another filter.
errores.recibo_incoherente: The result could not be verified. Check the pools or select “Recover result” to retrieve the receipt for the same load.
errores.resultado_indeterminado: No final response was received. The load may already be recorded. Select “Recover result” to retrieve the receipt for that same load.
